svg.aria-label: Mars Pathfinder tasks: high-priority bus management, medium communications and low-priority meteorological data sharing a mutex
svg.text: Mars Pathfinder, 1997: resets on another planet
VxWorks tasks sharing an information bus protected by a mutex
runs often; takes the bus mutex
occasionally publishes data; takes the mutex
The low task held the mutex; the medium task preempted it; the bus task waited too long; a watchdog
noticed the bus cycle hadn't completed and reset the whole system, losing data. Engineers reproduced it on a
ground replica, then uploaded a change enabling priority inheritance on that mutex (a flag already in VxWorks).
The lesson isn't that the team was careless: inversion only appeared under a rare timing combination on Mars,
and the fix was possible because debugging facilities were left in the flight software.
